en.html:
I pulled up the pitch. Up—further up.
To the enemy's back, where it could not bring the muzzle to bear.

Muramasa put her entire maneuvering performance into doing as I asked.
But I could tell. It was raising its own helmet horn, following, trying to keep me inside its field of fire.

Could we escape————!?

ja.html:
<ruby>兜角<rt>ピッチ</rt></ruby>を引き上げ、上へ――上へ。
　敵が砲口を向けようのない、その背面へ。

　村正は機動性能の全てを駆使して俺の要望に応える。
　だが――わかる。敵もまた兜角を上げて、俺を射界
に収めようと追ってきている。

　逃れられるか――――!?
